comment: Hotline removed the CBM80 cartridge header, so RESET and RESTORE do not restart the game.

Hotline wrote $0838, $0838 and three zero bytes over the start vectors and C, B, M of the CBM80 header. The bytes 8 and 0 stay. Only RESET changes: it does not restart the game. RESTORE does nothing in both releases, because the NMI handler is an RTI.
Hotline trainer (key T in its menu): calls the trainer routine in place of sta $5d,x / dec $93,x.

Hotline trainer (key T in its menu): calls the trainer routine in place of sta $5d,x / dec $93,x. Bug: the BMI at $870b still jumps to $8716, into the JSR. There the CPU does DEC $d0ea, ORA $098a and the illegal NOP #$85 and LAX $9ba9, then the STA $67,x of the original code. Thus during a hit animation no fighter loses energy, X becomes 2, and $d0ea (the colour register of sprite 3) decrements.

code:
sta $5d,x
cpx #$00
beq +
dec $93,x
+
lda $93,x
rts
!byte $00
comment: Hotline trainer routine: fighter 0 (player 1) does not lose energy.
Hotline changed this byte to $80. The game writes this byte at run time.
Hotline: other bytes in the NMI vector. The game writes $fffa-$ffff at its start, so they have no effect.
Hotline: other bytes in the IRQ vector. The game writes them at its start.
